text: GitHub Copilot 是一个 DSH 插件，通过 OAuth 设备码流程登录 GitHub，并把长期凭据写入 Harness 内置 github-copilot 提供方使用的授权记录。它在 Web 设置页和聊天命令中提供登录、状态查看与退出功能，支持沿用已有 OAuth token。适合希望在 DSH 中启用 Copilot 模型的用户；需要有 Copilot 权限的 GitHub 账号及 Harness 凭据服务，模型请求由内置路由处理。

GitHub Copilot adds device-code OAuth sign-in to DSH and stores credentials for Harness’s built-in provider. Use Web settings or chat commands to sign in, check status, and sign out; existing tokens can be adopted. Requires a Copilot-enabled GitHub account and the Harness credentials service.

GitHub Copilot 的功能「设备码登录」：在聊天命令或 Web 设置页启动 GitHub OAuth 设备流程，显示验证链接和用户码，并轮询授权结果后保存长期 token。
GitHub Copilot 的功能「凭据交接」：将长期 OAuth token 写入 Harness 内置 github-copilot 路由读取的 grant 记录，并可在凭据服务就绪时沿用已有 token。
GitHub Copilot 的功能「登录状态」：通过聊天命令或 Web 页面查看是否存在授权凭据；若下游路由已记录可用模型 ID，则显示数量。
GitHub Copilot 的功能「退出登录」：确认后删除本机 grant 及可写的 token 引用，并报告环境变量等外部来源是否仍提供凭据。
GitHub 登录会访问 github.com 的设备授权与 token 端点；此插件只发布凭据，实际 Copilot token 交换、模型目录和请求由 Harness 内置路由负责。
使用需要 Harness 凭据服务和内置 github-copilot 路由。退出操作不会清除启动环境提供的 token；若外部引用仍有值，状态会显示凭据仍然存在。

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · dsh-llm-github-copilot：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

GitHub Copilot sign-in for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · dsh-llm-github-copilot：This plugin provides a GitHub OAuth device-flow page and slash commands, then writes the credential used by the Harness's built-in `github-copilot` provider. It registers **no LLM adapter** and owns no model catalog: token exchange and refresh, model availability, requests, images, and streaming belong to the Harness's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` route. Available models depend on that route's catalog and your account's access, not just your Copilot plan. See [ADR-0002](docs/adr/0002-narrow-to-credential-provider.md).

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Requirements：- **Supported Harness releases:** `0.1.7-rc.1` through `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.1` through `0.2.0-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.1-rc.5`, with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `^4.0.4`. The development baseline is `0.2.1-rc.5`. The `0.2.2` alpha line is not supported yet; `0.2.2-alpha.3` runs only as a non-blocking CI preview.
- **Declared Harness peer range:** `^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.2` (see [`package.json`](package.json)). npm's moving `latest`/`next` tags are not a support guarantee. See the [0.2.1 compatibility assessment](docs/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3-compatibility-analysis.md) for validation scope.
- The Harness's bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` route and a credentials service such as `dsh-credentials-local`. The default Web profile supplies these; custom compositions must mount them.
- A GitHub account with access to Copilot.
- Node.js ≥ 24; pnpm ≥ 9 on `PATH` for `dsh plugin` commands.
@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Install：The commands below target the `web` profile. Its default directory is `~/.dsh/profiles/web`; if `DSH_HOME` is set, it is `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot -w
```

This installs the repository's default branch, which may contain unreleased changes. If pnpm asks for build approval, copy the **exact key it reports** into `allowBuilds` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then repeat the command. Do not guess the key from the repository name.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · From GitHub：`dsh plugin` registers this package in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and loads its bundled `cordis.patch.yml`. **Do not add another `insert` entry for this plugin to the profile patch.** If an older installation has a manual registration, remove that duplicate when using the bundle installation.

Stop any running instance, then start the profile again:

```sh
dsh web
```

Hard-refresh an already open browser tab after updating the plugin's client bundle.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Update：Use the Harness package manager so the profile's pnpm lockfile and bundle list stay in sync:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot --latest -w
```

For a specific release, replace `X.Y.Z` with its version:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot@X.Y.Z -w
```

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Update：A profile's pnpm `minimumReleaseAge` policy can delay newly published versions. If the installed version is older than expected, check that policy and, if appropriate, allow only the intended package/version through `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`, then install the exact version. Do not assume `@latest` selected the release you wanted, or mix `npm install` into a pnpm-managed profile.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Update：Restart DSH and hard-refresh the browser. Confirm the installed version at the bottom of **Settings → GitHub Copilot**, or run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web list @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot
```

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Sign in：Open **Settings → GitHub Copilot** and choose **Sign in**, or run this in a Harness chat:

```text
/copilot-login
```

Open the displayed GitHub verification URL, enter the device code, and authorize the GitHub App (VS Code). Polling continues on the Host and stores the credential automatically after authorization. The Web sign-in UI updates automatically; the chat-command dialog closes when sign-in is detected.

Check the stored credential state with:

```text
/copilot-status
```

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Sign in：`authenticated` means a long-lived token is present, **not** that a live API request succeeded. The command reports a model **count** only if the downstream route has recorded `availableModelIds`; it does not fetch or list models. Before the route's first token exchange, that count may be absent.

To remove the local credential:

```text
/copilot-logout
```

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Sign in：The Web UI asks for confirmation. Sign-out deletes the grant and any writable token reference; it does not revoke the GitHub authorization or remove the configured model provider. If a read-only reference or environment/`.env` fallback still supplies a token, the UI and commands explicitly report that sign-out is incomplete and tell you to remove the external token and restart. The status API exposes `credentialRemaining: true` in this case and never returns the token itself.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Use an existing OAuth token：You can supply a long-lived GitHub OAuth token instead of using the device flow:

```sh
export GITHUB_COPILOT_OAUTH_TOKEN='<your-github-oauth-token>'
dsh web
```

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Use an existing OAuth token：When the credentials service becomes available, the plugin adopts that token into the grant **only if no grant already exists**. An existing grant takes precedence over the environment/reference. On Harness versions where the environment-supplied reference is read-only, adoption writes the grant without attempting to overwrite the environment.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Use an existing OAuth token：Use a token from a compatible Copilot OAuth flow, not a short-lived Copilot API token. This plugin does not validate token prefixes or guarantee that an arbitrary PAT or `gh auth login` token has Copilot access.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Use an existing OAuth token：To sign out of an environment-token setup, remove the variable from the launching environment, restart DSH without it, then run `/copilot-logout`. Otherwise older Harness versions reject clearing the read-only reference; newer versions can clear the file override but still resolve the environment token. It may be adopted again on a later start.
@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Selecting a model：Signing in publishes a credential; it does **not** add a provider configuration.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Selecting a model：1. Open **Settings → Models**, separate from this plugin's sign-in page.
2. If it is not already configured, choose **Add provider** and select the built-in **`github-copilot`** entry. No custom endpoint or pasted API key is needed for the stored grant.
3. Save, then reopen the chat input's model selector and choose a model under `github-copilot`.
4. Send a request. The Harness route exchanges the long-lived GitHub token for a short-lived Copilot token as needed, refreshes it, and derives the account's endpoint.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Selecting a model：On the verified Harness baseline, the picker comes from the route's configured catalog. Opening it is **not** proof of an account-specific model discovery or successful authentication, and sign-out may leave catalog entries visible. The plugin neither filters those entries nor adds models absent from the downstream catalog. See the [model-list tracking issue](docs/issues/github-copilot-model-list-refresh.md).

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Selecting a model：If upgrading from an old adapter-based installation (through `0.4.5`), replace references to the removed `github-copilot-official` provider in settings and sessions with `github-copilot`, selecting a model available in the current catalog. An existing token reference is adopted automatically; no second sign-in is needed if that token is still valid.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Configure：The plugin works without configuration. Its only option is `oauthTokenEnv`, the credential reference/environment variable used to read an existing token and, when writable, store a copy after sign-in:

```yaml
- id: llm-github-copilot
  config:
    oauthTokenEnv: GITHUB_COPILOT_OAUTH_TOKEN
```

Put this **override**, not another `insert`, in the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Live settings use that profile patch, not a separate `settings.yaml` section.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Configure：The grant the route actually consumes always lives at `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot`; changing `oauthTokenEnv` does not move it or create a second account/provider. Models, endpoints, and request behaviour are configured under the Harness route's `llm-pi-ai` entry, not here.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Develop：Requires Node.js ≥ 24 and npm. Work in the repository root; edit `src/host/` and `src/client/`, not generated `lib/` files.

```sh
npm ci
npm run build      # concatenate source fragments → lib/index.js and lib/client.js
npm test           # test generated artifacts, credential handoff, i18n, metadata, and README contracts
npm run check      # build + artifact tests + npm pack dry-run (prepack runs the full test suite)

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Develop：For packed-installation and real-browser checks against the supported release candidates:

```sh
npx playwright install chromium
npm run test:harness -- 0.2.1-rc.2
npm run test:harness -- 0.2.1-rc.5
```

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Develop：These checks use a disposable `DSH_HOME` and simulated GitHub responses, not your credentials or a real Copilot request. CI also covers `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.3`, plus `0.2.2-alpha.3` as a non-blocking preview. See [the development workflow](docs/WORKFLOW.md) for test options and branch, PR, and release rules.

After all checks pass, optionally deploy into the local Web profile:

```sh
npm run deploy     # build → artifact tests → atomic deploy with rollback backup
```

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Develop：This copies the release files and runtime dependencies without running `npm install`; it does not register a missing bundle in the profile. For an initial checkout installation, build first and use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add . -w
```

After Host changes restart DSH; after Client-only changes a hard refresh (`Ctrl+Shift+R`) is usually enough.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Rollback a local deploy：`npm run deploy` backs up an existing installation under `${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/plugin-backups/dsh-llm-github-copilot/` and keeps up to five backup directories. Directory names include the version and timestamp.

Stop DSH, choose a backup, then replace the installed directory rather than copying into an existing one:

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Replace <backup-directory> above before running these commands.：test -d "$BACKUP" && mv "$PLUGIN" "${PLUGIN}.before-rollback-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)" && cp -a "$BACKUP" "$PLUGIN"
dsh web
```

This restores a local deploy's package files, not the profile manifest or lockfile. For an npm/GitHub-managed installation, install the desired release with `dsh plugin --profile web add …@X.Y.Z -w` instead.
section: Replace <backup-directory> above before running these commands.

text: @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Signed in, but no GitHub Copilot models appear：Confirm `github-copilot` is configured under **Settings → Models** (see [Selecting a model](#selecting-a-model)). If the settings page itself is missing, check the installed version and bundle registration, then restart DSH and hard-refresh. Repeated sign-in does not add a provider.
section: Signed in, but no GitHub Copilot models appear

text: @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · A model is missing, or a visible model rejects requests：Check the Harness route's catalog/configuration, your account and organization model policies, and the actual request error. The picker is not a live entitlement check. This plugin cannot extend the catalog or diagnose every missing model as an IP restriction.
section: A model is missing, or a visible model rejects requests

text: @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · `/copilot-login` reports a network error or stays pending：Check access to GitHub. Device-flow requests honor `https_proxy`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`http_proxy`/`HTTP_PROXY` (HTTP(S) proxy URLs) and hostname-based `no_proxy`/`NO_PROXY`. This transport applies only to this plugin's device flow, not the Harness route's model requests. Polling retries transient failures until the device code expires. While a flow is pending, `/copilot-login` reuses the same code; after expiry or denial, start sign-in again. Closing the dialog does not cancel Host polling.
section: `/copilot-login` reports a network error or stays pending

text: @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Token exchange fails, or a token was revoked：`/copilot-status` only checks that a token is stored. Short-lived Copilot token refresh is the Harness route's responsibility; a revoked or unusable long-lived GitHub token needs a new sign-in. Remove any ambient token as described above, sign out, then run `/copilot-login` again.
section: Token exchange fails, or a token was revoked

text: @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · `configurable provider "github-copilot" is already declared`：This plugin registers no model provider. Check for duplicate provider configuration, obsolete adapter registrations, or a manual plugin `insert` left alongside the bundle. Keep one plugin bundle registration and configure the built-in provider once.

@lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot README · Models remain in the picker after sign-out：Removing the credential does not remove the provider configuration. Catalog visibility and credential-based filtering belong to the Harness route; see the [tracking issue](docs/issues/github-copilot-model-list-refresh.md).
section: Models remain in the picker after sign-out
